text.aria-label: Subtitle text '13 primary substations, 365 daily forecast runs, July 2025 to June 2026. Each model was trained once, on one year of data. Each dot is one substation's mean difference in quantile score. Above zero: the old year is worse.'
text.tspan: 13 primary substations, 365 daily forecast runs, July 2025 to June 2026. Each model was trained once, on one year of data.
Each dot is one substation's mean difference in quantile score.
Above zero: the old year is worse.
